1: Grey dawn in a sixteenth-century army camp on the Basque coast: a rough wooden gallows stands against a pale sky, a coil of rope hanging loosely from the crossbeam, well above everyone's heads. Beneath it stands a lean Iberian young man in his twenties with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair and a short dark beard, bareheaded, in a plain sixteenth-century Spanish foot-soldier's quilted doublet and breeches, his hands bound in front of him, flanked by two soldiers with halberds seen from behind. His face is clearly visible, three-quarter view, very still, eyes lifted. Low mist, tents and a stone fortress wall in the background. Medium-wide shot. Solemn, no violence.
2: A column of sixteenth-century Spanish foot soldiers marching along a muddy road toward a dark stone fortress on a hill above a grey sea, pikes and halberds slanting against a stormy sky, banners hanging heavy. In the foreground, marching in the ranks, a lean Iberian young man in his twenties with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair and a short dark beard, in a plain quilted foot-soldier's doublet and a steel morion helmet, a pike on his shoulder; his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, tired and set. Hard low light from the side, mist on the road.
4: Grey dawn under a rough wooden gallows in an army camp: a mounted Spanish officer in a dark cloak and plumed hat sits on a black horse, one gloved hand raised in command; in front of him a soldier is cutting the rope that binds the wrists of a lean Iberian young man in his twenties with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair and a short dark beard, bareheaded, in a plain quilted foot-soldier's doublet. The young man's face is clearly visible in three-quarter view, stunned, looking up at the officer. A coil of rope hangs loosely high on the crossbeam above, out of reach. Mist, tents behind. Medium-wide shot.
6: A dusty country road across the Castilian plain at morning: a long column of sixteenth-century Spanish soldiers with pikes and banners marches past from left to right, raising dust. At the roadside a flock of sheep has scattered; a lean Iberian young man in his late twenties with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair and a short dark beard, a sheepskin over his shoulders, has just let his long shepherd's crook fall to the ground and steps toward the marching column, his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, resolved. Hard low sun from the side, long shadows.
7: Dusk on a dusty road leading up to a small whitewashed Portuguese hill town crowned by the dark crenellated walls of a ruined castle. A lean, weathered Iberian man of about thirty-seven with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn, patched soldier's doublet and a faded travelling cloak, a small bundle on his back and a walking staff in his hand, walks up the road toward the town. Medium shot from the side, his face clearly visible in profile, looking up at the town, tired and hopeful. Long shadows, mist in the valley below. Nobody else on the road.
